# USMail.AI

> AI-native print-to-mail platform (coming soon). Upload documents; USMail.AI prints, inserts, applies postage, and hands off to USPS. Certified Mail and Certificate of Mailing when needed. MCP for AI agents on the same production path.

## Status
- Product: Coming soon — early access open
- Billing today: Humans register an account and add funds to a prepaid meter
- Direct API keys for agents: Planned (not available yet)
- MCP server: Documented for indexing; production MCP availability with early access / launch
